thread:
Elaine (Docs): Quick heads-up — I drafted the deprecation comms for v1 -> v2. Need volunteers to own small PRs: links, SDK snippets, and a short migration example for model fallback behavior. Who can take what this sprint?
Sam (Eng): I can pick up the model fallback notes. Want to include example config for routing?
Elaine (Docs): Yes please. Keep it minimal: an example policy showing primary=v2, fallback=v1 and TTL for cache. Something copy-pastable.
Jon (SDK): I can do the SDK snippet updates and point out breaking changes. Please confirm we want both Python and TS examples.
Maria (Product): Yes both. Also add a short blurb about expected perf diffs after the swap — just a sentence with a link to the benchmark page.
Ash (DevEx): I’ll run a quick smoke of the snippets in the sample app and raise fixes. Tag me in the PRs.
Sam (Eng): Pushing a minimal YAML snippet in the PR now. Example: ```routing:
  default: redwood-v2
  fallbacks:
    - redwood-v1
  cache_ttl: 30s
```
Elaine (Docs): Nice. For the doc text, I want a short migration checklist: 1) Update client lib 2) Swap model & test fallbacks 3) Run sample app test. Keep it as a bullet list.
Jon (SDK): Heads-up: the v2 client renames `createCompletion` -> `generateText`. I’ll add both examples and a tiny compatibility note showing a 1-line wrapper.
Maria (Product): Also include migration window language and a timeline snippet. We have to avoid promising an exact date — say "rolling deprecation during Q3" and link to product announcement.
Elaine (Docs): Good call. I’ll add a line: "We’ll notify 2 weeks before enforced removal; current clients should follow the migration guide"
Ash (DevEx): PR plan: I’ll open three PRs: docs/content (checklist + comms), docs/snippets (python/ts updates), and docs/ops (routing example). Assign reviewers: @Jon for snippets, @Sam for ops, @Maria for comms.
Sam (Eng): Assigned. I’ll add tests to the ops PR: unit test for fallback selection and a small e2e test hitting the sample app endpoint.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for staging: docs/snippets -> staging at 2026-05-04T15:00Z :rocket:
Jon (SDK): One more: we need to fix two old links in the migration guide that point to the legacy model map. I’ll list them in the snippets PR.
Elaine (Docs): Perfect. If everyone can have PRs up by end of week I’ll draft the deprecation banner copy and coordinate with marketing. Any blockers?
Maria (Product): No blockers from PM. I’ll review the comms copy once it’s up.
Sam (Eng): No blockers. Pushing tests.
Jon (SDK): Working on the two snippet variants; ETA today.
Ash (DevEx): I’ll validate once PRs are open. Tag me for quick review. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Docs): Thanks all — I'll create a short checklist card in the docs board and drop links to the three PRs there. Closing thread once PRs are live.
_notes: Thread style: concise Slack coordination for docs + SDK migration work. Contains root message and sequential short replies, includes a code block and a deploy bot message.
